name: Turkiye
summary: Eurasian bridge nation with Anatolian plateau and Mediterranean coastline. Harnesses major hydroelectric, wind, and geothermal capacity while managing coal plant emissions in western basins.

pm25.name: Annual Mean PM2.5 Exposure
pm25.source_dataset: State of Global Air (SOGA) 2024 / Global Burden of Disease
pm25.context: 5.44x the WHO 2021 annual guideline (5 µg/m³); domestic lignite burning and transport emissions affect Ankara and Marmara basins.

temp_anomaly.name: Surface Temperature Anomaly
temp_anomaly.context: Relative to 1951-1980 baseline; heightened summer drought and forest fire incidence across Aegean coast.

temp_trend.name: 30-Year Warming Trend Rate
temp_trend.context: Linear warming rate across Anatolian plateau stations over 1994-2023.

co2_total.name: Total Territorial Fossil CO2
co2_total.context: 1.2% share of global fossil emissions; domestic coal and imported natural gas generate grid baseload.

co2_per_capita.name: Per Capita Fossil CO2
co2_per_capita.context: Near world average of 4.7 t CO2/person; industrialization expanding in central Anatolia.

forest_share.name: Forest Cover Fraction
forest_share.source_dataset: Global Forest Resources Assessment via World Bank (AG.LND.FRST.ZS)
forest_share.context: Contains ~226,000 km² of pine, fir, and oak woodlands across the Black Sea and Taurus mountains.

renewables_share.name: Renewable Share of Electricity
renewables_share.context: Diverse clean power base: hydropower (19.6%), onshore wind (10.4%), solar (5.7%), and geothermal (3.4%).

population.name: Total Population & Density
population.context: Arithmetic population density of 111 people/km²; urban population fraction is 77.0%.
